UniqueUsersWithImpressions.label: Impressions (unique users)
UniqueUsersWithImpressions.blurb: Players who saw the game surfaced to them. Falls in lockstep with DAU = a discovery/algorithm problem, not an in-game one.

RFYQualifiedPTR.label: RFY Qualified PTR
RFYQualifiedPTR.blurb: Play-through rate qualifying for Recommended-For-You. The gate on home-page promotion.

RFYL7PlayDays.label: RFY Play Days (L7)
RFYL7PlayDays.blurb: Play-days per player over 7 days — a Recommended-For-You ranking input.

AttributionD1RetentionRatio.label: Attributed D1 Retention
AttributionD1RetentionRatio.blurb: Day-1 retention of players attributed to a discovery surface.

Attribution7DPayerConversionRatio.label: Attributed 7d Conversion
Attribution7DPayerConversionRatio.blurb: Payer conversion within 7 days, by acquisition attribution.

Attribution7DPlaytimePerUserInMinutes.label: Attributed 7d Playtime
Attribution7DPlaytimePerUserInMinutes.blurb: Minutes played per attributed user over 7 days.

Attribution7DRobuxPerUser.label: Attributed 7d Robux/User
Attribution7DRobuxPerUser.blurb: Robux per attributed user over 7 days — acquisition quality in revenue terms.

ForwardD1Retention.label: Day 1 Retention
ForwardD1Retention.blurb: Of players who joined, the % who came back the next day. The hook test.

Attribution30DRobuxPerUser.label: Attributed 30d Robux/User
Attribution30DRobuxPerUser.blurb: Robux per attributed user over 30 days — the long-run value of a cohort.

ForwardD7Retention.label: Day 7 Retention
ForwardD7Retention.blurb: % returning after a week — the return loop / progression.

DauMauStickiness.label: Stickiness (DAU/MAU)
DauMauStickiness.blurb: How habitual play is: daily over monthly actives.

ForwardD30Retention.label: Day 30 Retention
ForwardD30Retention.blurb: % returning after a month — end-game. Often ~0 on a young game (normal).

DailyActiveUsers.label: Daily Active Users
DailyActiveUsers.blurb: Unique players per day. Size & momentum — don't compare raw across a growth spurt.

L7AverageForwardD1Retention.label: Day 1 Retention (7-day avg)
L7AverageForwardD1Retention.blurb: Day-1 retention, smoothed over 7 days. Breaking away from a flat genre benchmark is the cleanest game-specific-regression signal there is.

MonthlyActiveUsers.label: Monthly Active Users
MonthlyActiveUsers.blurb: Unique players over a rolling 30 days.

AverageSessionLengthMinutes.label: Avg Session Length
AverageSessionLengthMinutes.blurb: How long an average session lasts. Core engagement signal; also sets the benchmark bucket.

AveragePlayTimeMinutesPerDAU.label: Playtime per Player
AveragePlayTimeMinutesPerDAU.blurb: Minutes played per active player per day.

TotalPlayTimeHours.label: Total Playtime
TotalPlayTimeHours.blurb: Total hours played across all players.

L7AverageDailyActiveUsers.label: DAU (7-day avg)
L7AverageDailyActiveUsers.blurb: Daily active users, smoothed over 7 days.

UniqueUsersWithPlaySessions.label: Unique Players
UniqueUsersWithPlaySessions.blurb: Distinct players with a play session.

L7AveragePlayTimeMinutesPerDAU.label: Playtime/Player (7-day avg)
L7AveragePlayTimeMinutesPerDAU.blurb: Minutes per player, smoothed over 7 days.

TotalSessionsEndedInBucket.label: Sessions Ended
TotalSessionsEndedInBucket.blurb: Sessions that ended in the period.

AverageRevenuePerPayingUser.label: ARPPU
AverageRevenuePerPayingUser.blurb: Average revenue per paying user — the depth of paying.

PayingUsersCVR.label: Payer Conversion
PayingUsersCVR.blurb: The #1 metric: % of players who spend Robux. The width of paying.

PayingUsers.label: Paying Users
PayingUsers.blurb: Number of players who spent Robux.

AverageRevenuePerUser.label: ARPDAU
AverageRevenuePerUser.blurb: Revenue per active player — conversion × depth.

DailyRevenue.label: Daily Revenue
DailyRevenue.blurb: Gross Robux earned per day — contextualize with DAU growth.

ItemMonetizationRevenue.label: Item Revenue
ItemMonetizationRevenue.blurb: Revenue by source (Passes vs Dev Products). The idle-monetization thesis lives here.

ErrorCount.label: Script Errors
ErrorCount.blurb: Logged script errors — a VOLUME metric, so it falls when players leave. Normalise per DAU before calling a drop an improvement. Break down by MessageHash to find the individual bug.

PotentialExtraEarningsTotalUsd.label: Potential Extra Earnings
PotentialExtraEarningsTotalUsd.blurb: Estimated revenue left on the table (USD).

EventAvgDailyUserPlaytimeMinutes.label: Event Playtime
EventAvgDailyUserPlaytimeMinutes.blurb: Playtime per user during a scheduled event.

EventAvgDailyActiveUsers.label: Event DAU
EventAvgDailyActiveUsers.blurb: Average DAU during a scheduled event.

EventAvgDailyRevenue.label: Event Revenue
EventAvgDailyRevenue.blurb: Average daily revenue during a scheduled event.

UsersJoinedFromNotifications.label: Joins from Notifications
UsersJoinedFromNotifications.blurb: Players who came back via a notification — the re-engagement channel.

EventAvgRevenuePerDailyActiveUser.label: Event ARPDAU
EventAvgRevenuePerDailyActiveUser.blurb: Revenue per active user during a scheduled event.

RSVPCount.label: Event RSVPs
RSVPCount.blurb: Players who RSVP'd to a scheduled event.

AttributionD7RetentionRatio.label: Attributed D7 Retention
AttributionD7RetentionRatio.blurb: Day-7 retention of players attributed to a discovery surface.

EndToEndCVR.label: End-to-End Conversion
EndToEndCVR.blurb: Impression → play conversion across the whole funnel.

ClientCrashRate15m.label: Crash Rate (15m)
ClientCrashRate15m.blurb: % of sessions crashing within 15 min. A jump right after an update is the first thing to rule out.

ClientCrashCount.label: Crash Count
ClientCrashCount.blurb: Absolute client crashes. Read next to crash RATE — volume falls when players leave.

OomUnexpectedExits.label: Out-of-Memory Exits
OomUnexpectedExits.blurb: Sessions killed by running out of memory — the low-end-device tax.

RFYUniqueNotInterestedUsersPerMillionImp.label: "Not Interested" Rate
RFYUniqueNotInterestedUsersPerMillionImp.blurb: Players actively dismissing the game per million impressions — rising means the store listing is over-reaching.

ClientFpsP10.label: FPS (10th pct)
ClientFpsP10.blurb: Frame rate for the worst-off 10% of sessions — the low-end-device reality, not the average.

ClientMemoryUsageAvg.label: Avg Client Memory
ClientMemoryUsageAvg.blurb: Average client memory use. Read next to Memory Used % — the percentage is what predicts OOM kills, since the budget differs per device.

ClientMemoryUsagePercentageAvg.label: Memory Used %
ClientMemoryUsagePercentageAvg.blurb: Share of the device's memory budget consumed — closer to 100% means OOM kills.

MemoryUsageAvg.label: Avg Memory
MemoryUsageAvg.blurb: Average client memory use — lower is safer on low-end mobile, where most of the audience is.

CpuTimeAvg.label: Server CPU Time
CpuTimeAvg.blurb: Average server CPU time per frame. Break down by CpuTimeCategory to see which subsystem is eating it.

CpuCoreUtilization.label: CPU Core Utilization
CpuCoreUtilization.blurb: How saturated the server's cores are — sustained highs mean the server is the bottleneck, not the client.

PeakConcurrentPlayers.label: Peak Concurrent
PeakConcurrentPlayers.blurb: Most players online at once — traffic & server load.

ClientCpuTimeAvg.label: Client CPU Time
ClientCpuTimeAvg.blurb: Average client CPU time per frame — where render-submission cost shows up.

ServerFrameRateP10.label: Server FPS (10th pct)
ServerFrameRateP10.blurb: Server frame rate on the worst-off 10% of servers. Roblox caps at 60 — a drop here is server-side lag hitting real sessions, not an average smoothing it away.

SessionDurationSecondsAvg.label: Avg Session Duration
SessionDurationSecondsAvg.blurb: Average session length, reported in seconds (hourly resolution).

ClientFpsAvg.label: Avg FPS
ClientFpsAvg.blurb: Average client frame rate. Falling FPS shows up as shorter sessions before it shows up as churn.

FunnelUserChurnRate.label: Funnel Step Churn
FunnelUserChurnRate.blurb: % who drop out at each step — lower is better.

FunnelUserStepCompletionRate.label: Funnel Step Completion
FunnelUserStepCompletionRate.blurb: % of players who clear each onboarding step.

FunnelCohortCompletionRate.label: Funnel Completion (daily)
FunnelCohortCompletionRate.blurb: Share of each day's cohort reaching a funnel step. The ONLY funnel metric with a daily series — use it to date a progression break.

FunnelCohortSessionCompletionRate.label: Funnel Completion, sessions (daily)
FunnelCohortSessionCompletionRate.blurb: Same as above, counted per session rather than per user.

FunnelStepCompletionRate.label: Step Completion (event)
FunnelStepCompletionRate.blurb: Step completion counted per event rather than per user.

FunnelStepChurnRate.label: Step Churn (event)
FunnelStepChurnRate.blurb: Drop-out per step counted per event — lower is better.
